title: Bounded decoder experiment: 296 pair-total replacements fail the cost screen
body:
Adding one mixed centre could replace two scatter contributions with one. This bounded experiment checks that idea on the actual selected PR1094 delivery cut before attempting physical synthesis. **All 296 clean proportional pair-sharing variants fail the cost screen, even with additional implementation costs granted free.**

The precise mechanism is `H=C_i+lambda*C_j`: on a nonempty subset where `d_j=lambda*d_i`, replace both old contributions by `d_i*H`; retain all coefficients elsewhere, the other six centres and all non-centre paid work. All 28 unordered centre pairs, induced ratio classes and their nonempty subsets are covered. This changes the term count and cut supports; it is not another eight-term all-pairs search.

## Result and evidence

- 296 exact candidates; 265,216 rational carrier-basis coefficient checks. Canonical cut coefficients are cross-bound to the emitted forward program.
- Only four candidates tie total centre mass at 64. Each replaces two rank-eight children by `(7,7,2)`, a strictly more expensive recursive profile. All other cases pay 65–68 centre units.
- Best favorable primitive ceiling: bracket `(0.001689680763861, 0.001689680763862)`, below the selected word's relaxation bracket `(0.001690054109088, 0.001690054109089)`. These are packing-relaxation ceilings, not attained kappa or runtime measurements.
- All candidates fail the predeclared 5% gate and even the zero-percent comparison of those relaxed profiles. The written concavity argument shows their moment is pointwise worse for `0<a<1` under the fixed retained-work model.
- The complete candidate table is canonically hashed. A separate integer/explicit-vector implementation reconstructs every case, the six rank patterns and the best witness without importing the primary or supplier modules. Numerical roots use the credited, pinned PR1240 engine; independent numerical repricing is not claimed.

## Sources, scope and coordination

Seven new files only in `research/centre-cut-pair-sharing/`: two checkers, exact compact receipt, README/proof, TASK, SOURCES and registered VERIFY manifest.

Base main: `99aea7503041c2bd559e69bacb7ef12b4fa9a552`; contribution `9fca8c97`. Selected PR1094 source head: `0fc329d0bec93ca7cd288eaea1295172e8789810`. The selected 480-helper word is read from the reviewed replay archive and bound to the slot recipe's canonical payload pin. No ancestor evidence/local word, upstream file, frozen package or selected record is modified.

The user selected a changed-decoder follow-up to [our PR1643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1643). The exact refinement, favorable budget and stopping rule were recorded before computation. [Discussion1645](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1645) holds the claim and handoff. Complete pre-submission metadata pagination covered 532 open PRs and 300 Discussion records; the focused search found our package/claim only. Metadata search does not establish novelty over all historical/private code.

This is the selected sparse 176-edge cut acting on prepared carrier values. PR845/1071 concern a full P112 Gram fixed-coordinate-reader family, and PR1633 concerns all-pairs excess-rank classification; neither result is claimed anew.

## Verification and limits

The registered Windows CPython 3.12.14 replay passed all three commands:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/centre-cut-pair-sharing
```

Primary normal and optimized checks pass with eight semantic/accounting controls. Secondary optimized replay passes with three separate failure witnesses. Metadata/source pins and staged whitespace checks pass. Repository onboarding helpers were unchanged; their previously observed Windows portability errors were not rerun or folded into this result. Hosted Linux CI is separate.

The budget counts every residual and added COPY, all retained non-centre work and ideal idle mass, while granting zero extra preparation, carrier-frame promotion, dirt repair, phase/precision/scalar and physical hosting overhead. This rejects the declared fixed-profile mechanism; it is not a completed physical invoice. No native A/B/cleanup redesign, target waiting schedule, full local phase/scalar replay, owner admission, global exact moment, outer composition or cold supplier replay was performed. The comparison is to the selected word's packing relaxation, not a general exclusion of improvements to its currently attained packing.

One-sided cancellation, direct regathering that changes the source frame, multiple added totals, altered non-centre work and other coverage laws remain outside scope. The next question is recorded with a first step and blocker, rather than supplying an unverified promising candidate. No new supplier, kappa, formal multiplication theorem, merge or closure is requested.
